identity.title: ALMA observations of the dense and shocked gas in the nuclear region of NGC 4038 (Antennae galaxies)
identity.journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of Japan

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present 1$''$ ($<$100 pc) resolution maps of millimeter emission from five molecules–CN, HCN, HCO$^{+}$, CH$_{3}$OH, and HNCO–obtained towards NGC 4038

evidence.quote: redshifted to the velocity of 1638 km s$^{-1}$

question.value: Where are the dense, shocked and star-forming gas in the nuclear region of NGC 4038, and do molecular shocks arise from inflowing gas colliding with the central molecular complex?

evidence.quote: The purposes of this study are to reveal dusty star forming regions using dense gas tracers and continuum emission, and search for the presence of gas inflows
ALMA Science Verification data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00003.SV

bands.value: Band 3 (3 mm) multi-line; Band 7 CO (3-2) SV

evidence.quote: The uncertainty of absolute flux calibration is 5% in Band 3

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 4 spws, 1.875 GHz bandwidth each, 488 kHz resolution; coverage 87.78–91.51, 97.15–99.02, 111.56–113.43 GHz

evidence.quote: The total frequency coverage is 7.47 GHz (87.78–91.51 GHz, 97.15–99.02 GHz, and 111.56–113.43 GHz).
five molecules (CN, HCN, HCO$^{+}$, CH$_{3}$OH, and HNCO)
We used ALMA CO (3–2) Science Verification (SV) data
The number of available 12 m antennas ranged from 31 to 33 depending on the observing run.
The synthesized beam sizes range between 0.68$''$ and 0.92$''$
The MRS of our data is 1.3 kpc

sensitivity.value: 1.8–2.4 mJy/beam per 10 km/s channel; 3 mm continuum 0.05 mJy/beam

evidence.quote: range between 1.8 mJy beam$^{-1}$ and 2.4 mJy beam$^{-1}$
carried out using ALMA on July and August, 2014

provided.value: 6 cm and 4 cm continuum for spectral index

evidence.quote: we reimaged the 6 cm and 4 cm continuum emission using the VLA archival calibrated data (PI: A. Pedlar)
assuming the CO (3–2)/(1–0) line ratio of 0.6, which was measured using the CO (1–0) and CO (3–2) maps of NGC 4038
We use a Galactic CO-to-H$_{2}$ mass conversion factor $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ = 4.35
the HCN-to-dense gas mass conversion factor $\alpha_{\rm HCN}$ = 10

pipeline_or_manual.value: CASA 4.3.1 calibration; SV data self-calibrated per CASA guide

evidence.quote: According to instructions in the CASA guide, we applied self-calibration to the calibrated visibility data
(CASA; Ver. 4.3.1)
Absolute flux calibration was performed using Ceres.
The uncertainty of absolute flux calibration is 5% in Band 3

weighting_robust.value: Band 3: natural; CO(3-2) SV: Briggs robust = 0.5

evidence.quote: We used natural weighting of the visibilities for imaging to obtain the highest sensitivity.
by adopting Briggs weighting of the visibilities (robust = 0.5)

continuum_subtraction.value: continuum maps made from line-free channels

evidence.quote: We made the 3 mm continuum map using the line free channels.

smoothing.value: Discussion maps clipped to similar shortest uv range (12–14 kλ), convolved to 1.2''

evidence.quote: created with visibilities clipped to have similar shortest uv range (uv distance = 12-14 k$\lambda$), and convolved to 1.2$''$ angular resolution
The synthesized beam size is 1.11$''$ $\times$ 0.65$''$
The rms noise level at the velocity resolution of 10 km s$^{-1}$ is 4.7 mJy beam$^{-1}$.

what.value: SV CO(3-2) self-calibration and imaging follow the CASA guide

evidence.quote: According to instructions in the CASA guide, we applied self-calibration to the calibrated visibility data

what.value: Dense gas fraction conversion factors same as previous study

evidence.quote: using the same conversion factors as the previous study (cite: Bigiel15)

unstated_but_needed: Spectral smoothing kernel and spatial smoothing in MOMNT moment maps
Clumpfind parameters beyond the 2 sigma threshold

analysis_steps.goal: Calibrate and image Band 3 data and SV CO(3-2) data

method.value: CASA calibration and imaging; natural weighting for Band 3; SV self-calibration, Briggs 0.5

evidence.quote: Data calibration and imaging was carried out using the Common Astronomy Software Applications package (CASA; Ver. 4.3.1).

method.value: smooth and clip cube at 1.5 sigma per channel with MOMNT

evidence.quote: This cube was clipped at the 1.5$\sigma$ level per channel.

method.value: Reimage VLA 6 and 4 cm with matched uv range (9.7 kλ), convolve to 1.2''

evidence.quote: We clipped the visibilities so that the VLA and ALMA data have the same shortest uv range (9.7 k$\lambda$) and convolved both data to 1.2$''$ angular resolution.

validation.value: extrapolated 3 mm flux compared to observed

evidence.quote: This is consistent with the observed value within the error.

analysis_steps.goal: Line ratios and dense gas fraction

method.value: HCN/CO(3-2) converted to HCN/CO(1-0) with 0.6, then masses with alpha_CO and alpha_HCN

evidence.quote: We convert the HCN (1–0)/CO (3–2) line ratios into HCN (1–0)/CO (1–0) line ratios, assuming the CO (3–2)/(1–0) line ratio of 0.6
Assuming the CO (3–2)/CO (1–0) line ratio of 0.7 and 0.5, the average dense gas fraction changes to $\sim$20% and $\sim$14%

method.value: Clumpfind on CO(3-2) SV cube with 2 sigma threshold; velocity comparison with rotation

evidence.quote: using the recommended 2$\sigma$ threshold to identify robust molecular clumps
(CASA; Ver. 4.3.1)
using the AIPS task, MOMNT
automatic clump identification algorithm Clumpfind (cite: Williams94)

results_numeric.quantity: gas mass within 0.6'' of CO peak
CH3OH/HNCO peak ratio at CH3OH peak

evidence.loc: 4.4 Different distributions of two shock tracers

findings_qualitative.value: CH3OH, HNCO and CN detected for the first time in NGC 4038 nucleus; 3 mm continuum is free-free dominated

evidence.quote: Three molecules (CN, CH$_{3}$OH, and HNCO) were detected for the first time in the nuclear region of NGC 4038.

claims.result: CN/HCN ≈0.8–1.2 near 3 mm and 850 um peaks

evidence.quote: The CN (1–0)/HCN (1–0) line ratios are enhanced (CN/HCN $\simeq$ 0.8–1.2) in the star forming regions

claims.hypothesis: Shocks driven by inflow colliding with central complex
claims.experiment: Clumpfind on CO(3-2) and velocity comparison with shock tracers
claims.result: Inflowing gas component connects with Complex 1 where shocked gas is seen

evidence.quote: We note that we cannot completely reject other possibilities (e.g., outflow)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Star-formation outflows rejected as unlikely, requiring 3.2 outflows pc^-2 across a few 100 pc

evidence.quote: it is unlikely that such star-forming regions is forming across a few 100 pc$^{2}$

limitations_admitted.value: Dense gas fraction uncertain due to assumed CO(3-2)/(1-0) ratio and conversion factors

evidence.quote: our estimation has a large uncertainty because the dense gas fraction changes depending on the assumed CO (3–2)/CO (1–0) line ratio

referee_caveats_inferred: Single CO(3-2)/(1-0) ratio and Galactic alpha_CO applied to a starburst nucleus
Inflow interpretation based on velocity geometry in a disturbed system
